description: Render one page of a PDF as a PNG image block, optionally cropped to `region` and with rectangles drawn over `highlight`. Use it to see a page before editing it, or to check the result afterwards.

file.description: The PDF: an absolute (or ~) local path, which this server uploads for you, an https:// URL the API fetches, or an `f_…` file id from an earlier call.

format.description: Image encoding: 'png' (lossless) or 'jpeg' (keeps the asked-for scale on busy pages; the response is image/jpeg). (default: "png")

scale.description: Pixels per point, 0.25 to 3 (fractions allowed); the scale actually used is in X-Preview-Scale. (default: 2)

name: pdf_preview
title: Render a PDF page
